opening.speaker: Jagen
opening.text: Prince Marth, Caeda has come from Talys Castle.

opening.speaker: Marth
opening.text: What happened, Caeda? Did something happen at the castle?

opening.speaker: Caeda
opening.text: Prince Marth, I'm so glad to see you! The Galder pirates suddenly attacked us. They took over the castle, and many people were killed! Please, save my father!

opening.speaker: Marth
opening.text: Don't worry, Caeda. The brave knights of Altea are here in this fort. We won't lose to those pirates. Come, let's go to Talys Castle together.

village_west.speaker: Talys Villager
village_west.text: Oh, you're the prince of Altea! It's like a dream to be able to meet you... Um... This Vulnerary is a small token of my appreciation. Please accept it.

village_east.speaker: Talys Elder
village_east.text: Prince Marth, thank you for coming. Here is 5000 gold that the villagers have collected. Please use it to equip yourselves, and save this country from the Galder pirates.

village_non_lord.speaker: Villager
village_non_lord.text: Your highness, the village is waiting for you with its gates open. Please go and visit them soon.

house_weapon_tips.speaker: Villager
house_weapon_tips.text: Some powerful weapons cannot be used unless your weapon level is high enough. Those who fly in the sky should be wary of bows.

house_fort_tips.speaker: Villager
house_fort_tips.text: If you are wounded, rest in the forts. A short rest will make you feel better again.

house_galder_rumor.speaker: Villager
house_galder_rumor.text: Galder is a port town to the west of Talys Island. Currently, a man named Gomer is in control, and it has become a pirate stronghold.

house_aurelis_news.speaker: Villager
house_aurelis_news.text: It seems that Princess Nyna of Archanea and Lord Hardin of Aurelis are fighting together against the Dolhr Imperial army, which invaded Aurelis. It seems like they are having a hard time, so you should go and help them quickly.

boss_gazzak.startCombat: What? The Altean army!? If we let you guys walk all over us, it would ruin the name of us pirates! ...Die!
boss_gazzak.death: Guh... defeated by these Altean brats...!

ending.speaker: King Mostyn
ending.text: Oh, Prince Marth, I am glad you made it here safely. I would like to express my gratitude. So... You're finally setting off for Aurelis?

ending.speaker: King Mostyn
ending.text: In that case, I will provide a small number of soldiers. These men, led by Captain Ogma, are all brave warriors. I'm certain they will help you in battle.

ending.speaker: King Mostyn
ending.text: There is one other thing. It is very important, so please pay attention. From now on, wherever your highness goes, you will surely find many people who hate the Dolhr Empire.

ending.speaker: King Mostyn
ending.text: Some of them are hiding in villages, while others have been captured by the enemy. There will even be some that are siding with the Dolhr Empire only reluctantly. Finding these people and fighting together with them is crucial.

ending.speaker: King Mostyn
ending.text: Do you understand, Prince Marth...? Well, now the time has come! Please do not overexert yourself. Embark on your journey with caution. Good luck!
